limits: opencode run exposes no --temperature and no --seed flag, so neither reaches the model. Repeated seeds are repeats, not independent samples, and a spread of 0.00 is not an error bar.

The free tier reports no usage block. Token counts are chars/4 estimates, not provider tokenizer output. Ratios between arms remain meaningful because both use the same estimator; absolute figures are not provider figures.
Caches inside the provider cannot be disabled or measured from here. --standalone removes the shared opencode session cache only.
Tool use cannot be prevented on this CLI; a run that invoked a tool is voided rather than scored, so the guarantee is detection, not prevention.

protocol.note: Free-tier models reached through `opencode run --standalone`. The CLI has no --temperature and no --seed flag, so neither reaches the model: `repeats` are repeats, not independent seeds, and a spread of 0 is not an error bar. Token counts are chars/4 estimates because the free tier reports no usage block.
protocol.toolPolicy: A run that invoked any tool is voided, not scored. Tool use cannot be prevented on this CLI, so a cheating model produces a failed run rather than a prevented one.
